note: The Greys, a mystery faction of saucers and a manta that watch, blind, strike and take: their bolts, their four ships and their bands in the star systems. The scene builder (CarrierBuilder.Greys) reads this and bakes the numbers into the prefabs (Prefabs/GreysScout, GreysShroud, GreysLance, GreysReaper) and the levels: run Tools > Carrier > Build Everything after changing anything here. Models and hardpoints: Models/Greys_<Id>.fbx and Data/greys_<id>_hardpoints.json (Tools/Blender/build_greys.sh). Units as in vrask.json. What's new beside the Vrask's fields: signature (how much of a sensor's range a ship is seen at: Signature), cloak (the share of it kept cloaked: Cloak), designatorRange (a targeting laser: Designator), ecm (a jammer: radius, strength 0 to 1, pdRadius where it scrambles missiles and drones, ghosts: EcmEmitter), emp (an EMP burst: radius, strength in hull points, chargeTime, cooldown: EmpBurst), drones (a drone bay: stock, maxOut, perLaunch, launchInterval, launchRange: DroneBay). Their hulls carry no armour plating. A bolt of kind Emp knocks a component out (ShipSystems).

ships.weapons: Precision beams, 2 drones, a targeting laser
ships.role: Deep reconnaissance: cloaked, it shadows a ship at the edge of its sensors, paints it for the rest and calls them in; slips away when anything closes; hit-and-run with its beams and drones when a shield is down

ships.weapons: Jammer and ghost projectors, an EMP burst, an EMP projector
ships.role: Electronic warfare: jams sensors, aim, missiles and comms over 6 km, puts ghost contacts on the sensors and hides its escorts; scrambles missiles and drones close in; an EMP burst and projector; escorts the Reaper
Precision strike: fast runs from the flank and the rear, its salvo on engines and weapons, breaking off; runs down cripples; strikes facilities in its way and screens the Shroud and Reaper from craft

ships.weapons: Tractor emitters, an abduction beam, light rim guns
ships.role: Capture: holds back while the others work, then locks its tractor emitters on a disabled ship (no warp while held), abducts its crew, cargo and a sample, and can tow it off as the group withdraws

group.name: Greys cell
group.note: Something watches from the cold rocks of the Outer Drift: ships that come out here go quiet on the comms.
